cards.ex: We need to cut down on our energy consumption to reduce our carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Biz uglerod izimizni kamaytirish uchun energiya sarfini qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir miqdorini kamaytirish, ayniqsa sarfni.

cards.ex: Flying less is one way to reduce your carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Kamroq uchish - uglerod izingizni kamaytirishning bir usuli.
cards.uzDef: Shaxs yoki tashkilotning atrof-muhitga ta'siri, uglerod chiqindilari orqali o'lchanadi.

cards.ex: More people are trying to go green by recycling and using less plastic.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq odamlar qayta ishlash va kamroq plastik ishlatish orqali yashil bo'lishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit uchun foydali bo'lgan hayot tarziga o'tish.

cards.ex: Investing in renewable energy is crucial for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga investitsiya qilish barqaror kelajak uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qayta to'ldirilishi mumkin bo'lgan manbalardan olingan energiya, masalan, quyosh yoki shamol.

cards.ex: Schools are promoting environmental awareness among students.
cards.exUz: Maktablar o'quvchilar orasida ekologik xabardorlikni oshirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit muammolari haqida xabardor bo'lish va ularga e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: Climate change is a serious threat to our planet.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi sayyoramizga jiddiy tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidagi ob-havo sharoitlarining uzoq muddatli o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Eco-friendly products are becoming more popular.
cards.exUz: Ekologik toza mahsulotlar tobora ommalashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydigan yoki kam zarar yetkazadigan.

cards.ex: We need to sort out the recycling before taking it to the center.
cards.exUz: Markazga olib borishdan oldin qayta ishlash uchun narsalarni saralashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarni guruhlarga ajratish, ayniqsa qayta ishlash uchun.

cards.ex: Global warming is causing glaciers to melt at an alarming rate.
cards.exUz: Global isish muzliklarning xavotirli darajada erishiga sabab bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer atmosferasining o'rtacha haroratining asta-sekin ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: Conservation efforts are vital to protect endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlarni himoya qilish uchun muhofaza qilish harakatlari juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni va atrof-muhitni himoya qilish bo'yicha qilinadigan ishlar.

cards.ex: Proper waste disposal is essential for public health.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri chiqindilarni yo'qotish jamoat salomatligi uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Chiqindilarni xavfsiz va samarali tarzda yo'q qilish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Sustainable development is key to ensuring a healthy planet for future generations.
cards.exUz: Barqaror rivojlanish kelajak avlodlar uchun sog'lom sayyorani ta'minlashning asosiy omilidir.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlarning ehtiyojlarini qondirish imkoniyatlariga zarar yetkazmasdan, hozirgi ehtiyojlarni qondirish.

cards.ex: Burning fossil fuels releases harmful greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Qazilma yoqilg'ilarni yoqish atmosferaga zararli issiqxona gazlarini chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'mir, neft va tabiiy gaz kabi million yillar davomida hosil bo'lgan yoqilg'ilar.

cards.ex: Deforestation can disrupt the ecological balance of an area.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi hududning ekologik muvozanatini buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil organizmlar va ularning muhiti o'rtasidagi muvozanat.

cards.ex: Don't just throw away that bottle; recycle it!
cards.exUz: Bu shishani shunchaki tashlab yubormang; uni qayta ishlang!
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsalarni tashlab yuborish.

cards.ex: We need to assess the environmental impact of this new project.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu yangi loyihaning ekologik ta'sirini baholashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Inson faoliyatining atrof-muhitga ta'siri.

cards.ex: Air pollution is a major problem in many cities.
cards.exUz: Havo ifloslanishi ko'p shaharlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Havoning zararli moddalar bilan ifloslanishi.

cards.ex: Water conservation is important, especially in dry regions.
cards.exUz: Suvni tejash muhim, ayniqsa qurg'oqchil hududlarda.
cards.uzDef: Suv resurslarini himoya qilish va tejash amaliyoti.

cards.ex: Many species are in danger of dying out due to habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlar yashash joylarining yo'qolishi tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida.
cards.uzDef: O'z turining oxirgi vakili o'lishi va turning mavjud bo'lmay qolishi.

cards.ex: We must manage our natural resources responsibly.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiiy resurslarimizni mas'uliyat bilan boshqarishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat tomonidan ta'minlangan va odamlar tomonidan ishlatiladigan materiallar (suv, o'rmon, minerallar).

cards.ex: The greenhouse effect is intensified by human activities.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona effekti inson faoliyati tufayli kuchaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer atmosferasida issiqlikning ushlanib qolishi, haroratning ko'tarilishiga olib keladi.

cards.ex: Stricter environmental regulations are needed to protect our planet.
cards.exUz: Sayyoramizni himoya qilish uchun qattiqroq ekologik qoidalar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qabul qilingan qonun va qoidalar.

cards.ex: Protecting the eco-system is crucial for the survival of many species.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlarning omon qolishi uchun ekotizimni himoya qilish juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jonli organizmlar va ularning atrof-muhiti o'rtasidagi o'zaro bog'liqlik.

cards.ex: Remember to turn off the lights when you leave the room.
cards.exUz: Xonadan chiqayotganda chiroqlarni o'chirishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Elektr asbobini yoki yoritgichni ishlamay qoldirish.

cards.ex: Adopting a sustainable lifestyle can make a big difference.
cards.exUz: Barqaror turmush tarzini qabul qilish katta farq qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga kam zarar yetkazadigan hayot tarzi.

cards.ex: Protecting natural habitats is crucial for biodiversity.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy yashash joylarini himoya qilish biologik xilma-xillik uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'simlik yoki hayvonning tabiiy yashash muhiti.

cards.ex: Energy efficient appliances can save you money on your electricity bill.
cards.exUz: Energiya tejamkor jihozlar sizning elektr to'lovingizda pulni tejashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kamroq energiya sarflaydigan.

cards.ex: Environmental protection is everyone's responsibility.
cards.exUz: Ekologik muhofaza - har bir insonning mas'uliyati.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni ifloslanish va buzilishdan himoya qilish.

cards.ex: We organized a community event to clean up the park.
cards.exUz: Biz parkni tozalash uchun jamoat tadbirini tashkil qildik.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarni tartibga keltirish va axlatdan tozalash.

cards.ex: We should all try to conserve resources like water and energy.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz suv va energiya kabi resurslarni tejashga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy resurslardan oqilona foydalanish, ularni saqlash.
